findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Analysis/Distribution/TestFunction/SmulLeft.lean:61` defines `smulLeftCLM (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) : 𝓓^{n}(Ω, F) →L[ℝ] 𝓓^{n}(Ω, F)`. No lemma in the diff mentions both `cutoffCLM` and `smulLeftCLM`.
findings.fix: Add `monoCLM ℝ (cutoffCLM hχ hχU φ) = smulLeftCLM hχ φ` (for `U ≤ Ω`), or `cutoffCLM hχ inter_subset_right = smulLeftCLM hχ` on `Ω`. Alternatively, define `smulLeftCLM` through `cutoffCLM`.
findings.issue: The docstring says `cutoffCLM` is `TestFunction.smulLeftCLM` when `U = Ω`, but no lemma states this. That leaves two parallel multiplication operators with no stated link, and users cannot move results between them.

findings.evidence: SmulLeft.lean:70 `coe_smulLeftCLM`, :75 `tsupport_smulLeftCLM_subset`, :82 `smulLeftCLM_smulLeftCLM`, :91 `smulLeftCLM_monoCLM`. In Gluing.lean, `hsplit` and the `hglue` calc reprove these facts pointwise each time.
findings.fix: Add `coe_cutoffCLM` (`⇑(cutoffCLM hχ hχU φ) = χ • ⇑φ`), `tsupport_cutoffCLM_subset` (`⊆ tsupport χ ∩ tsupport φ`), `cutoffCLM_cutoffCLM`/product form, and a `cutoffCLM_monoCLM` lemma, mirroring SmulLeft.lean.
findings.issue: `cutoffCLM` has only `cutoffCLM_apply`. It lacks the lemmas that its sibling `smulLeftCLM` has and that this PR's own proofs work around with `ext; simp`: the coercion form, the support bound, composition of two cutoffs, and interaction with `monoCLM`.

findings.evidence: Gluing.lean:59-61 (`θ`, `hφ`, `hψ`) and :120-121 (`ψ`, `hψ`). The same `⟨φ, φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport, h⟩` pattern also appears in Mass/Basic.lean:277, Sobolev/WeakDeriv/Local.lean:66, BoundedVariation/TotalVariation.lean:150 and others.
findings.fix: Add a public lemma in the TestFunction layer, e.g. `TestFunction.exists_monoCLM_eq_of_tsupport_subset (hφ : tsupport φ ⊆ U) : ∃ ψ : 𝓓^{n}(U, F), monoCLM ℝ ψ = φ` (or an iff with `Set.range`), and use it at both sites.
findings.issue: The general fact that a test on `Ω` with `tsupport φ ⊆ U` equals `monoCLM ℝ ψ` for a test `ψ` on `U` is rebuilt inline with an anonymous constructor plus an `ext; simp`. It happens here and again at line 59 (`θ` in `apply_eq_apply_of_coe_eq`). The statement mentions only Mathlib types, so it is infrastructure that should be public.

summary: `cutoffCLM` ships with only a pointwise `_apply` lemma: no link to the existing `TestFunction.smulLeftCLM` (its docstring claims they agree when `U = Ω`) and none of the companion lemmas `smulLeftCLM` has. The restriction of a test supported in `U` to a test on `U` is rebuilt by hand twice instead of being exposed as a lemma.
